passages.texte: 4. Go-Live. Quillon shall make the Production Environment available to Customer no later than December 7, 2026 (the "Go-Live Date"), subject to Customer completing its onboarding obligations under Schedule B (KYC data for the initial seller cohort and certification of its webhook endpoints) no later than five (5) business days before the Go-Live Date.

4.3 Service Credits. If the Production Environment is not available by the Go-Live Date for reasons attributable to Quillon, Customer shall receive a credit equal to five percent (5%) of the monthly Platform Fees for each full week of delay, up to a maximum of twenty-five percent (25%). Such credits are Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

faits.texte: The Tradewell go-live date is 7 December 2026.
Tomer Golan owns the Tradewell cutover on Quillon's side.
If go-live is late for Quillon's reasons, Tradewell gets a credit of 5% of monthly platform fees per full week of delay.
Ellen Vance is the owner on Tradewell's side.
